slides.title: Don't Worry, I'll Do It

runs.t: By the end of class, you can do these six things.
I can offer help with I'll.
The phone's ringing. I'll get it.
I can ask Will you…? → Yes, I will.
I can understand Do you want me to…?
I can choose will or going to.
I can write a text message offering help.

slides.notes:
Read each goal slowly. Learners repeat.
Goal 1: offers with I'll (The phone's ringing. I'll get it.). Goal 2: promises (I'll call you back. Don't worry, I won't forget.). Goal 3: Will you…? → Yes, I will. / No, I won't.
Goal 4: understand Do you want me to…? and Shall I…? Goal 5: will (decided now) or going to (planned before). Goal 6: read a school flyer and a sign-up sheet, and write a short text message offering help.
"We check at 7:25" = the Progress Check. It is not a test grade.

Listening script (the audio is coming soon; until then, read it aloud with a volunteer at a normal, friendly speed):
Narrator: Lesson five. Listening. Carmen and David are parents at Hillside School. Carmen is calling David. Listen.
Carmen: Hi, David. It's Carmen. It's about the family night at school on Friday.
David: Oh, right. How can I help?
Carmen: We need someone to set up the tables and chairs.
David: No problem. I'll set them up. I'll come early, at five.
Carmen: Thank you! And Rosa is going to bring pizza. She ordered it yesterday.
David: Great. What about drinks?
Carmen: Hmm. No one has the drinks yet.
David: OK, I'll bring the drinks. Juice and water.
Carmen: Perfect. Can you also make a flyer?
David: I'm going to be very busy at work this week. But my sister can make one. I'll ask her and call you back tonight.
Carmen: Will you call me before eight?
David: Yes, I will. I promise. Don't worry, I won't forget.
Carmen: Thanks, David. I'm going to clean up after the event.
David: I'll help you clean up, too. See you on Friday!
Narrator: That's the end of the listening.

runs.t: going to: I PLANNED IT BEFORE

slides.notes:
Box 4 (3 min): draw two pictures on the board: a light bulb (an idea now → I'll) and a calendar (planned before → I'm going to). Read Box 4 across. Each click shows the going to side of one row.
I'll = I decide now (an offer, a promise, a quick decision). going to = I planned it before (I bought the ticket; I ordered the pizza). Don't spend a long time on cases where both are possible.
Check questions: "The phone's ringing. I ___ get it." ('ll) • "I bought a ticket. I ___ visit my mom." ('m going to) • "Don't worry, I ___ forget." (won't)

runs.t: My car won't start, and I have to go to work.
Don't worry. I'll give you a ride, because I'm going that way.

slides.notes:
Step 5 · 7:00–7:12 · Talk Time: Problem / Offer Cards + Event Board · 12 min.
Round 1, pairs (5 min): A reads a problem card (My car won't start.). B offers help with I'll… and one reason or detail. A says thank you. Switch after each card. Try to use all 8 cards. Each click shows the next step.
Model with one learner (1 min): read card 1. Help the learner say "I'll give you a ride." Answer: "Really? Thank you so much!"
Cards: 1 My car won't start, and I have to go to work. 2 I forgot my dictionary at home. 3 I have five heavy boxes in my car. 4 My boss called, but I was in a meeting. 5 My kitchen is a mess after the party. 6 Thirty people are coming, and we have no chairs. 7 It's raining, and I don't have an umbrella. 8 I don't know how to send a photo by text.
Sample offers: 1 I'll give you a ride. 2 I'll lend you mine. 3 I'll help you carry them. 4 I'll call him for you. / I'll text him. 5 I'll help you clean up. 6 I'll set up the chairs. 7 I'll lend you an umbrella. 8 I'll show you. / I'll help you.
Useful: Don't worry. No problem. I'll… Thanks! That's very kind. You're the best!
Lesson plan: Step 5; Talk Time: Problem / Offer Cards; Answer key.

slides.notes:
Progress Check · 7:25–7:30 · 5 min. Individuals. Open the Progress Check page.
Part A: read each sentence slowly, 2 times. Learners circle a (decided now) or b (planned before). Then click to show the answer (one click per item, 1 to 4).
Say: 1 "OK, I'll carry that box for you." (a) • 2 "I'm going to visit my sister on Sunday. I bought the bus ticket." (b) • 3 "Don't worry. I'll call you back in five minutes." (a) • 4 "We're going to have a party next week. We sent the invitations." (b)
Parts B and C: learners do them alone. Walk around and help with the instructions only. B answers: 1 will, 2 won't, 3 open, 4 are going to. C: answers will vary (for example I'll carry it for you. / I'll give you a ride.).
Part D: read each "I can…" line aloud and point to the 3 faces: 😀 "I can do it." 🙂 "With a little help." 😐 "Not yet."
Scoring: A /4 + B /4 + C /2 = /10. This is not a test grade. It shows who needs more help hearing will vs. going to (A) and with the forms (B, C).
Collect the pages (or check them at the start of Week 6). If behind: do the Progress Check in Week 6 at 6:00, while learners arrive.
